title: Pure Fire King
summary: The 2023-24 Fire King deck with generic staples. Fire Kings destroy their own FIRE monsters on purpose, and every destruction summons or searches the next one. Legendary Fire King Ponix searches a Fire King Spell/Trap, Fire King Sanctuary places Fire King Island, and Island destroys a monster in the hand or field to search a Fire King. Fire King Courtier Ulcanix, the newest card, destroys a FIRE monster to search a FIRE Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast and summons High Avatar Garunix when it falls. Sacred Fire King Garunix and Fire King High Avatar Kirin come back whenever a FIRE monster is destroyed. On the opponent's turn, Sanctuary Xyz Summons Garunix Eternity, which wipes the other monsters, and the Avatars negate by destroying another FIRE monster. Cursed Fire King Doom Burst needs a Fiend Tuner, so it stays out.
